author: Arnav
problem: Read N and a string S of length N with an even number of double quotes. Replace every comma that is outside the quoted parts (between the 1st and 2nd quote, the 3rd and 4th, and so on) with a period, and print the result.
bug_description: Replaces commas when the quote count is odd (inside quotes) instead of even (outside).

comments.accurate: Tracks whether we're inside quotes and turns the commas outside them into periods
comments.wrong_behavior: Tracks quote parity and turns the commas inside quoted text into periods
comments.wrong_location: Quote tracking verified; check the result is rebuilt from the modified list, not the original string
